title: Sync to live counts what Apply can write over the whole preview, not its first 500 items
steps: Run the host answer case and the push dialog case for a preview of 500 conflicts and later writable items.
expect: The answer lists writable items before conflicts and carries pushable totals by group over the whole changeset.
The dialog reviews, not 'nothing', and its headings and confirm line count the whole changeset.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=counts pushable items over the whole|capped at the host answer
tests: the preview answer counts pushable items over the whole changeset, not only the items it lists
a preview capped at the host answer counts what Apply can write over the whole changeset
